items.heading: INSTALL WATER PUMP OVER NEW GASKET
items.text: Install the water pump over a new gasket with eight bolts and one nut.

items.heading: INSTALL FAN BELTS, FAN BELT GUIDE AND PULLEY
substeps: (a) Check the fan belts for cracks or damage.
(b) Place fan belts on the pulley, and position the pulley and fan belt guide on the bolts of the water pump.

items.heading: INSTALL FLUID COUPLING AND FAN SHROUD
substeps: (a) Install the fan shroud together with the fluid coupling into the engine compartment.
(b) Install the fluid coupling on the pulley with four nuts.
(c) Install the four fan shroud bolts.

items.heading: START ENGINE AND CHECK FOR LEAKS
